# Caret voice

Follow [the editorial contract](../../../docs/editorial-contract.md). Use current instructions and authorized private examples to understand the author's voice. If unavailable, say so and use a neutral draft for review.

Preserve the author's chosen wording and rhetorical intent. Do not impose an expert-vulnerable persona, first-person story, ban on bullets, or mandatory connector substitutions. Prefer specific meaning over generic polish. Never invent a personal experience, quote, emotion or authority signal. Ask for missing personal detail only when it matters.
